_doc: The rules of the Assisted plugins (Assisted EQ, Comp, Reverb and Delay). tools/build_assisted.py writes these numbers into the generated table blocks of the JSFX and GFX files and into native/common/AssistedTargets.hpp; edit them here and run it. Order of the lists: targets and sources as below, EQ regions low, mud, honk, presence, air.

eq._doc: flavor: dB per region that the target adds on its own (Natural is flat). hpf/lpf: the target's own high-pass / low-pass in Hz (0 = none). source_ref: the region levels, in dB against a -4.5 dB/oct slope levelled at 500 Hz-4 kHz, that a healthy source of this kind shows; Learn corrects the measured levels toward these. source_hpf: the range in Hz where a learned high-pass may sit for that source. correction: the share of a measured deviation that is corrected; deadband: deviations smaller than this (dB) are left alone; max_cut / max_boost: the limits of a learned correction in dB.

comp._doc: reduction: dB of gain reduction the target aims for on the loud parts (the 90th percentile of the 50 ms levels). ratio: per source, plus ratio_add per target. attack: ms for a low crest factor (9 dB and below) and a high one (15 dB and above), scaled by attack_mul per target. release: share of the mean time between onsets, kept between release_min and release_max ms (release_none when no onsets were found). loudness: the integrated loudness in LUFS that Output aims for after Learn (0 = leave the level alone); loudness_share: the share of the loud parts' reduction the loudness is taken to lose (makeup gives back half of it).

reverb._doc: decay: RT60 in s per target, times decay_mul per source; with learned onsets it is kept under decay_onsets onset intervals (min decay_min s). size: the room (comb lengths) per target. predelay: pre-delay in ms = predelay_share of the learned onset interval times predelay_mul per target, kept in predelay_range (predelay_none ms without onsets). lowcut: Hz per source (the target's lowcut_target if higher). highcut: Hz per target, moved by the learned brightness: one octave per bright_db dB above or below bright_ref, kept in highcut_range. mix: wet level per source (linear, added to the dry signal), times mix_mul per target and Amount. duck: dB the wet dips while the dry signal is loud, per source, times duck_mul per target.

delay._doc: note: the delay time in beats at the host tempo per target (0 = a slapback of slap_ms). pingpong: 1 = the echoes alternate left and right. repeats: how many echoes stay within 30 dB, per target; with learned onsets closer together than the delay time it is scaled down to (onset / time), at least half. lowcut: Hz per source, in the feedback loop. highcut: Hz per target in the feedback loop, moved by the learned brightness as in reverb, kept in highcut_range. mix: echo level per source (added to the dry signal), times mix_mul per target and Amount. duck: as in reverb.
